handbookNote: Maine Driver's License Manual (Maine Secretary of State / Bureau of Motor Vehicles, Rev 4/24 edition, under Secretary of State Shenna Bellows), fetched directly from the official BMV site at maine.gov/sos/bmv -- PDF at maine.gov/sos/sites/maine.gov.sos/files/inline-files/Maine Driver License Manual_1.pdf, linked from the BMV's 'Driver License Manual and Maine Motorist Handbook and Study Guide' page. Full text extracted to temp/handbooks/me/driver.txt (a new file, separate from the existing me notary handbook files in that folder). Real exam mechanics CONFIRMED from the official BMV 'Drivers License Exam' page (maine.gov/sos/bmv/driver-licenses-and-ids/car-license/drivers-license-exam): 'The knowledge test consists of 30 questions, and you must answer a minimum of 24 correctly to pass the test' -- i.e. 30 questions, 24 correct minimum, an 80% passing threshold. That page does not state a time limit for the written test, and no time limit was found on any other official BMV page reviewed, so whether the real test is timed is UNCONFIRMED (not stated by the source) rather than assumed untimed. Content-depth rationale: the 12-section, ~40-page manual (License/GDL rules, State Laws & Vehicle Registration/Insurance/Inspection, Fitness to Drive incl. fatigue/distraction, a very detailed Alcohol/Drug/OUI section with specific BAC thresholds and suspension periods, Seatbelt/Child Safety law text, Vehicle Operation basics, Rules of the Road/right-of-way/signs/signals, General Driving incl. passing/parking/school buses, Speed & Space Management with a stopping-distance chart, Avoiding Crashes/Emergency procedures, Sharing the Road with pedestrians/bicycles/motorcycles/large vehicles, and Special Driving Challenges incl. Maine-specific moose/deer collision guidance) comfortably supported 285 distinct, individually-cited multiple-choice questions across 12 topic buckets, each grounded in a specific manual passage -- no invented facts or filler.
